name: Aeldari (Guardian Battlehost)
note: User-supplied export '1k sc', 1995 pts. A DETACHMENT PAIR at exactly the budget - Armoured Warhost 1 DP plus Guardian Battlehost 2 DP - and the two grant DIFFERENT Force Dispositions (Reconnaissance and Take and Hold), so declaring Take and Hold here is a real list-building choice rather than the only answer. It buys no Enhancement at all. The first roster here that fields the SAME entry more than once: two Guardian Defenders blocks with their own Farseer and Warlock Conclave, two War Walkers units, two D-cannon Platforms. The export names the Avatar WARLORD; nothing in this engine reads a warlord, so it is recorded here and nowhere else.

roster.note: 10 models, so TWO Aspect Shrine tokens - granted at build time as starting strength // 5, never written down. The export prices this at 140, the transcribed points list at 150: one of the three standing deviations this list carries (verify_rules_vs_engine.py reports all three).

The second copy, identical to the first. Nothing distinguishes them but the copy number the builder appends to the squad name - which is the identifier the AI's plan orders, the map rosters and a saved scene all address a unit by.

The two Power Swords are ADDRESSED to models 4 and 5 rather than counted, so they land on Guardians that did NOT give up their Shuriken Pistol for a Flamer or a Fusion Gun. The export does not say which models carry what - both distributions are legal - so this follows the call the other shipped Aeldari list already made for the identical loadout.

The only Aeldari entry priced by how many copies the army already fields: 110 for the first, 125 for the second. The export prints both numbers, which is what makes the tiering visible at all - and whether either platform joins a Guardian Defenders block is NOT this file's call - Support Artillery puts that decision in the Declare Battle Formations step, where the pre-game panel offers it.
The Exarch keeps its printed default - Scorpion Chainsword, Scorpion's Claw and Shuriken Pistol - so this entry takes no wargear option at all.
